svg.title: The 600-cell in the H4 Coxeter plane
svg.desc: The 120 vertices of the 600-cell, which are the 120 unit icosians, projected onto the H4 Coxeter plane (Coxeter number 30). The points fall on four concentric rings of 30, coloured by ring, joined by the 720 edges between vertices 36 degrees apart, drawn faint. Every vertex has 12 neighbours. Coordinates are computed.
svg.text: The 600-cell in the H4 Coxeter plane
The 120 unit icosians, seen along the plane in which the Coxeter element is a rotation by 12°.
Vertices are unit quaternions, so radii
120 vertices, 720 edges, 4 rings of 30, computed: H4 Coxeter element of order 30, eigenplane for exp(2πi/30).
